scientific_predecessor.reason: Original 160 individual plant/session source plus 160 stigma plant keys; only 145 complete mother rows, 13 source nbGr_mean NA, 3 source pl_mean NA, 15 unique excluded. One of the 16 original sessions has fewer than six complete mothers; registered gate was >=120 total and >=6 in all 16. Never reinterpret that gate as passed.

exploratory_followup.changes_from_earlier_model: ONLY allow the one low-completeness session to be held out without dropping it; all eligible 145 plants included. No threshold removal or moving a source outcome. Original source primary COVERAGE_STOP stays historical and intact.
exploratory_followup.response: Original nbGr_mean, log1p (mature seeds per sampled fruit, NOT plant lifetime seed output).
exploratory_followup.M0: identical to original lock: intercept + categorical poll_treat indicators + log1p(nb_visit) + log1p(nb_flo_all) + log1p(height_max)
exploratory_followup.M1: identical to original lock: M0 + log1p(pl_mean)
exploratory_followup.fit: identical Gaussian ridge lambda1, training-only zscore, unpenalized intercept, 2 independent solvers
exploratory_followup.validation: one whole session out, all 16 original sessions, including the one with <6 complete mothers; 145 eligible plants scored once
exploratory_followup.results: report all 16 session sizes and M0/M1 MSE/MAE, pooled plant-weighted loss, relative comparison, win count, no p-value or significance claim
exploratory_followup.decision_classification: EXPLORATORY_POSTSTOP_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NEVER_CONFIRMATORY, irrespective of direction, prior original 5% and >=12/16 rule may be shown descriptively but MUST NOT be treated as preregistered support
exploratory_followup.scientific_contribution: checks whether the frozen modeling architecture predicts across source sessions despite one underpowered session; exploratory feasibility, NOT new general law or natural fragmentation replication
exploratory_followup.source_outcome_policy: Original source P and F values remain private in GitHub Actions; only aggregate fold-level results may be committed.

strict_stop: Do not silently rewrite original source coverage or previous QPF001/QPF004 negative results
No removal of underpowered session or treatment-level post-hoc tuning
No decision gate based on result sign. A positive original loss difference is still exploratory and not an independent confirmatory result.
No original individual plant IDs, source raw data, stigma pollen, number of seeds or individual offspring paternity disclosed
16 sessions of one manipulated Brassica experiment do not increment six-source natural landscape QPF registry.
